run_Trainer: run the Trainer to extract embeddings and softmax probabilities from an ImageNet dataset using a pretrained model
save_TrainerState: save the TrainerState model checkpoint to a file for later resumption of feature extraction
load_TrainerState: load a TrainerState checkpoint from a file to resume feature extraction with the saved model
checkpoint_Trainer: checkpoint the Trainer to save state and handle job preemption in a distributed cluster environment
convert_conv_numpy_tensor: convert a CUDA tensor to a numpy array for saving extracted embeddings and labels to disk
